neighbours.label: the period ending a factual statement that sets up a topic (a definition or a dated fact), with more to come
fire: Serotonin is a chemical messenger. It affects mood and sleep.
A heat pump is a device for moving thermal energy. It runs on electricity.
The Battle of Hastings was fought in October 1066. It changed England.
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants make sugar. It needs light.
The term habeas corpus needs to be defined first. Broadly, it protects liberty.
A glacier is a slow river of ice. Most lie near the poles.
The Treaty of Utrecht was signed in 1713. It ended a long war.
An enzyme is a protein that speeds up a reaction. Each has a target.
quiet: Serotonin is a chemical messenger that affects mood and sleep in most mammals
A heat pump is a device for moving thermal energy that runs on electricity
The Battle of Hastings was fought in October 1066 and changed England for good
Photosynthesis is the process by which plants use light in making their sugar
The term habeas corpus needs to be defined first because it protects liberty
A glacier is a slow river of ice and most of them lie near the poles
The Treaty of Utrecht was signed in 1713 and ended a long and costly war
An enzyme is a protein that speeds up a reaction and each has its own target

notes: Card: '.' x23 and '.\n' x5 of the top 32, mostly after definitions and facts in encyclopedic prose. Probes: 'fought in 1915.' 0.400, 'energy conversion device.' 0.351, 'a neurotransmitter.' 0.277; 'The bus stopped.' 0.141, 'Hello there.' 0.078.
